# P1.16 — Billing, full: plans, trial entitlement, usage dashboard

Spec: `docs/tickets/44_P1.16__billing-full.md` · run ledger: `docs/build/runs/P1.16.md`
**Stage A only** — all code + deterministic tests, $0 spend. Stage B (deploy + the live
Checkout/Portal/Tax purchase legs + the prod trial legs, ≤$5) is operator-gated →
**D-P1.16-1**. Stacked on `stevevitali/p1-15-ingestion` (PR #69); merge operator-held.

## Summary

The post-beta billing system end to end (§14.2/14.3/14.5/14.6 + §5.6 trial rendering):
the Free/Writer/Studio/Studio Max ladder with Team waitlisted, Stripe Billing via
Checkout + Customer Portal + Tax, the 14-day trial entitlement with its abuse controls
and kill switch, included-credit rollover/expiry, opt-in auto-reload, the four-level
usage dashboard with server-computed flags, the weekly estimator re-fit, parked-run
re-pricing across rate-table changes, and every named §14.6 failure state under test.

**`@rhema/contracts`**: `domain/pricing.json` is the single source of truth — validated
at module load (`validate()` throws on drift from the §14.2 literals: $20/$100/$200
monthly, −15% annual, 2,000/12,000/26,000 included, packs 1,000/5,250/22,000, 1¢ peg,
1.4× platform rate, trial 14 d / 6,000 words / 150-cr pocket / 800-cr promo / 250k daily
ceiling). `pricing.ts` exports `PRICING`, `planOf`, `priceCents`, `topUpPack`,
`modelTierAllowed`, `effectiveConcurrency`; `trial.ts` the account/entitlement state
machines + `decideTrialUnlock` (pure: fingerprint-reuse deny → disposable deny →
ceiling pause → risk challenge → allow); `usage.ts` the `AccountUsage`/`ProjectUsage`/
`RunSummary`/balance-chip read-model types — **no `tokens` at levels 0–2**.

**Migration `0036_billing_full.sql`**: subscriptions gain Stripe ids, `billing_cycle`,
`cancel_at_period_end`, `scheduled_tier`, the renewal-failure markers (`renewal_failed_at`,
`downgrade_warned_at`); billing_accounts gain the trial machine (`trial_state`,
`trial_killed_at`, `fingerprint_hash`, `phone_verified`), `stripe_customer_id`, the
auto-reload columns (enabled/threshold/pack/month-cap/spend counter), and the §14.2
top-up fraud-bound counters (first-month $100, daily 3DS threshold); trial_entitlements
widen to `locked/revoked/converted` + audit columns; new `trial_unlock_checks`,
`trial_spend_daily`, `checkout_sessions` (return-to-context + grant discriminator),
`auto_reload_events`, `estimator_fits`/`estimator_config`, `team_waitlist`;
`runs.repriced_at`/`repriced_from_version`; `admin_actions` gains `trial_kill`.

**`@rhema/ledger`**: `subscriptions.ts` — `activateSubscription` (idempotent on the
Stripe sub id), `grantIncludedCredits` with the ≤2× rollover cap (the excess expires as
`rollover_cap`), `applyRenewalPaid`/`applyRenewalFailed` (past_due + notify, balance
still spends), `changePlan` (upgrade now + grant; downgrade schedules to period end),
`requestCancellation`/`endSubscription`, and `runBillingPeriodTick` — the hourly
deterministic half: period-boundary included grants (idempotent, whichever of the
Stripe arm or the tick lands first wins), scheduled downgrades, the 7-day warning →
14-day lapse to Free, the Free-tier 10-credits/day allowance. `trial.ts` —
`provisionTrial` (locked entitlement at signup), `gateTrialUnlock` (the
identity-before-spend gate: fingerprint/disposable/ASN/ceiling evidence + an audited
`trial_unlock_checks` row every attempt; allow ⇒ entitlement `locked→unused` + the
150-cr pocket granted expiring at window end), `recordTrialSpend` (the global daily
ceiling inside the hold tx), `convertTrialOnUpgrade` (void pocket → 800-cr `promo`,
idempotent), `sweepExpiredTrials`, `killTrial` (≤60 s is real — `SqlHoldLedger.hold`
reads `trial_killed_at` under the hold's lock). `checkout.ts` — `startCheckout`
persists the `checkout_sessions` row FIRST (the webhook resolves it), `return_to`
carries the origin surface. `stripe.ts` gains the arms: `checkout.session.completed`
dispatches on our row's kind (subscribe → activate + trial conversion; topup → the
PACK's credits, never `amount_total`; auto_reload_setup → card on file; no row ⇒ the
unchanged beta Payment-Link arm), `invoice.paid` → renewal + included grant,
`invoice.payment_failed` → past_due + notify, `customer.subscription.created|updated`
→ sync (an unknown `created` activates whole — the Checkout race arm), `.deleted` →
end. `stripe-port.ts` — the narrow `StripePort` (Checkout/Portal sessions + the
off-session charge), `StubStripePort` for tests/dev, `FetchStripePort` (thin REST, no
SDK, `automatic_tax[enabled]` + 3DS request when the daily bound trips). `usage.ts` —
levels 0–2 builders + level-4 drill-down + RFC-4180 CSV, all inside tenant txes.
`estimator-refit.ts` — the weekly REQ-BILL-7 re-fit: evidence row every run, the
multiplier steps only on ≥N samples, clamped [1.25, 1.5]. `reprice.ts` —
`repriceParkedRun` re-estimates a parked run under the current rate table inside the
resume tx (negative/no delta resumes; positive delta returns for the spend gate).

**`apps/api`**: `billing-routes.ts` adds the full surface — `GET /billing/plans`
(pricing.json verbatim), `POST /billing/checkout` (subscribe/topup/auto_reload_setup;
top-ups need a paid plan, first-month $100 cap, >$200/day → 3DS — attempt-counted
conservatively at session creation), `POST /billing/portal`, `GET /billing/subscription`
(plan + trial + auto-reload + past-due flag), `POST /billing/subscription/cancel` +
`/change-plan`, `GET /billing/checkout-sessions/:id` (the return poll),
`PUT /billing/auto-reload` (typed threshold + pack + monthly cap — validated),
`POST /billing/team-waitlist`, `GET /billing/usage` + `/usage/account` +
`/usage/project/:id` + `/usage/run/:id/advanced` + `/usage.csv`; the pre-existing
`GET /pricing/rates` publication stays (its `pricing-routes.test.ts` contract is
unaffected — `pricing.json` now also pins the 1.4× / 1¢ figures it publishes).
`run-routes.ts` gains the server-derived plan gate inside the create tx: Free is
chat-only (non-chat → 402 `upgrade_required`), model tiers gate per plan (402
`model_tier_requires_upgrade`; trial pins Base → 422 `trial_base_only`), concurrency
per plan (429 `concurrency_limit`; trial = 1), Writer's ≤40 runs/day (429
`daily_run_ceiling`), and the §14.3 trial path — `entitlementId` runs the unlock gate
(disposable → 403 `trial_denied`, risk → 403 `phone_challenge_required`, ceiling → 429
`trial_ceiling`, killed → 403), then the shape check (Review · Standard · Base → 422
`trial_shape`) and the 6,000-word cap (422 `trial_word_cap`). `signup.ts` provisions
the locked trial. `admin-cli.ts` gains `trial-kill`. `sheet-context`/`timeline`/
`editor` routes surface plan flags + entitlement facts for the *Included* rendering.

**Live binding (Stage-A code, operator-seeded value)**: `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY_NAME` resolves the
`stripe-secret` value from Secret Manager at boot → `FetchStripePort` on api (`server.ts`) and
worker (`main.ts`, auto-reload only); a placeholder value counts as unconfigured (PRB.17 pattern),
unset ⇒ checkout/portal 503 `stripe_unconfigured` and the sweep logs `no_stripe_port` — never a fake
session, never a fabricated charge. Pulumi wires the env on both services (`requires("stripe-secret")`
gated) and grants `api-reads-stripe` IAM.

**`apps/worker`**: `stripe.event` processes the new arms (notify rides the queue);
three new crons — `billing.period-tick` (hourly: boundary grants, scheduled
downgrades, grace-window warn→lapse, trial expiry, daily Free allowance),
`billing.auto-reload` (hourly; **refuses to run without a live Stripe port** — a
no-port sweep never fabricates a charge), `billing.estimator-refit` (weekly);
parked-resume runs `repriceParkedRun` inside the resume tx and a positive cap delta
opens a `confirm_cost` gate instead of silently proceeding (the delta hold is
`newCap − stillHeld`; insufficient-balance/suspended consent rolls back; stop cancels
and releases the original hold — `steering.test.ts` + `gate-resolution.test.ts`).

**`@rhema/api-client`**: the full DTO set + methods (plans, subscription, checkout,
portal, cancel, change-plan, checkout-session poll, auto-reload, waitlist, usage
levels 0–4, `downloadUsageCsv` returning bytes/mediaType/fileName, rates publication).

**`apps/web`**: `/settings/billing` — the plan card (ladder with pricing.json prices,
subscribe→Checkout forms, top-up packs, change-plan, cancel-at-period-end, Portal,
opt-in auto-reload with user-typed cap, Team waitlist form, the trial card's *Included*
rendering, the past-due renewal banner); `/billing/return` — the ≤30 s webhook-lag
poll (completed → "Payment confirmed" + returnTo continue link; open → auto-refresh +
"we'll email you"); `/usage` — the pre-existing glance extended
to the §14.5 level-1 account read (plan/period line, per-bucket bars, MTD spend,
rollover warnings, next expiry, CSV link); `/usage.csv`; `/p/:project/usage` —
level-2 rollup with per-run cost and report links; `/pricing/rates` — the rates
publication rendered as a page; `/app/usage/r/:runId` — the run-report deep-link
redirect. No public marketing routes were added (the route
manifest test still pins that).

## Acceptance criteria

| AC | Status |
|---|---|
| Subscribe/change/cancel/top-up/auto-reload round-trip; `checkout.session.completed` + `invoice.paid` → `grant(included)`; return-to-context | ✅ deterministic (`subscriptions`/`checkout`/`stripe` tests); live leg → D-P1.16-1 |
| Entitlement run: hold/debit against `Run.entitlementId`, zero credit-ledger writes, *Included* rendering, >6,000-word offer | ✅ `trial.test.ts` + `run-routes.test.ts` + `billing-pages.test.ts` |
| Unused entitlement + pocket → 800-cr promo on upgrade | ✅ `trial.test.ts` + the subscribe-arm test |
| Abuse controls: fingerprint/disposable/ASN/ceiling/kill ≤60 s | ✅ `trial.test.ts` + `run-routes.test.ts` (8 gate tests) + `admin-cli` `trial-kill` |
| Rollover ≤2× + 7-day warning; top-up expiry; auto-reload opt-in + user-capped | ✅ `subscriptions`/`usage`/`auto-reload` tests |
| Four read models; no `tokens` at 0–2; advanced behind disclosure; flags; CSV 1–2 | ✅ `usage.ts`/`usage.test.ts` + web surfaces |
| Every §14.6 failure state a named test | ✅ test map in the run ledger |
| `/pricing/rates` publication; run reports carry `rate_table_version`; pricing.json single source | ✅ `pricing-routes.test.ts` + `pricing.test.ts` |
| Gates green; ledgers updated; `D-P1.16-*` ids | ✅ this PR + run ledger + D-P1.16-1; D-P0.11-2 closed |
| **Stage B (operator-gated, ≤$5)** | ⏸ → **D-P1.16-1** |

## Not in this PR (Stage B → D-P1.16-1)

`pulumi up` (the code-side wiring is in this PR — `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY_NAME` →
`FetchStripePort` on api + worker, `api-reads-stripe` IAM, crons registered — the
operator seeds the `stripe-secret` value + configures the Stripe webhook endpoint
and Tax nexus), real Checkout subscribe/top-up round-trips, the Portal plan-change, Stripe
Tax on a real invoice, the live `invoice.paid`/`payment_failed` cadence, the trial
legs on prod (signup → unlock checks → *Included* entitlement run → kill-switch
within 60 s → ceiling assert), auto-reload live charge, parked-across-rate-change on
a live deploy.

REQs satisfied: REQ-SPEC-8, REQ-BILL-7…12, 14, 16, 17, 19; REQ-GROWTH-4/7/8/10/14/15;
REQ-SPEC-24 items 3+8; REQ-PERSONA-5; REQ-DATA-42.
